## Citation correction

The description cites ADR 0018 as authority for enforceable plan review before claim. That citation is incorrect. ADR 0018 governs the T5c trust-boundary scope gate. It does not establish plan-review claim enforcement.

The historical decision to enforce plan review for the transition from `open` to `in_progress` is recorded in ticket `messy-moose-jig`. The current claim-gate behavior and attestation protocol are documented in `docs/plan-review-gate.md`.

This correction is append-only. The original description and GitHub metadata remain unchanged.
